To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

eFindSite, a new version of FINDSITE that employs meta-threading, advanced machine learning and auxiliary information, improves the accuracy of ligand binding site prediction in protein models by 15–35 % over the previous version of FINDSITE and by 5-40 % over the state-of-the-art pocket detection algorithms.

(i) meta-threading and meta-template approaches are more effective for binding site detection and prediction than the conventional template-based approaches; (ii) the inclusion of auxiliary ligand information improves the ranking of predicted binding sites; and (iii) a large number of binding residues can be identified for the majority of proteins in a genome.

eFindSite, our improved version of FINDSITES, a method that uses meta-threading, improved clustering techniques and machine learning methods, outperforms geometric algorithms in binding site detection by 15–45 %, in binding residue prediction by 5–30 % and, in the most difficult case, identifies 14 %.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the prediction of protein binding sites.
protein function prediction, which can be divided into two main steps: (i) protein structure prediction, and (ii) ligand binding prediction.
the development of computational methods for predicting protein–ligand binding sites and for identifying ligands of proteins.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this paper presents an improved version of the FINDSITE method, which is a meta-threading approach for predicting ligand-binding sites in protein structures.
eFindSite is a powerful and reliable computational tool for the accurate prediction of ligand-binding sites in protein models.
eFindSite is a highly accurate and robust method for the prediction of ligand-binding sites, which outperforms other state-of-the-art algorithms.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
eFindSite is an improved version of our previous method FINDSITE.
eFindSite is a powerful tool for the prediction of ligand-binding residues in protein models, especially when the templates are only weakly homolougs to the target protein.
eFindSite provides a reliable and robust tool for ligand binding site prediction in protein structures, which can be used for large-scale annotation and drug development.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, by using a meta-threading approach, it is possible to identify ligand binding pockets in protein models that share only 20–40 % sequence identity with their template structures.
the use of meta-threading, advanced clustering, machine learning and confidence estimation techniques can greatly enhance the prediction performance of binding site detection algorithms.
meta-threading, clustering and machine learning techniques can be combined to produce a reliable and efficient tool for ligand binding site prediction.
